about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: Two villas, one philosophy
about.story: Villa Ballena and Villa Beluga were born from a deep love for Istria — its rolling hills, truffle forests, and sun-drenched coastline. Built in 2021 in the heart of Svetvinčenat, just steps from a medieval castle, these two sister villas represent our vision of what a perfect Mediterranean retreat should be: private, beautifully designed, and deeply connected to the land.
about.philosophy: We believe luxury should feel effortless. No check-in desks, no rigid schedules, no compromise. Just thoughtfully designed spaces, warm hospitality, and the freedom to create your own rhythm. Whether you're here for a quiet wellness escape or a lively family celebration, we want you to feel at home — in the most extraordinary way.
